items.text: Introduced, as one of its lead sponsors, a bill to tax household wealth above about 260 times the median household's wealth at 2 percent a year and above about 5,000 times it at 3 percent, reaching about the richest 0.15 percent of households. Its sponsors estimate it would raise about 1.7 percent of annual economic output a year.
Cosponsored from its introduction a bill raising the national minimum wage by about 135 percent by 2030 and ending the lower minimums for tipped, young, and disabled workers.
Cosponsored a bill that adds penalties for employers that violate workers' organizing rights, bars mandatory anti-union meetings, and lets unions collect fees from every worker they represent.
